title: PoWER Never Corrupts: Tool-Agnostic Verification of Crash Consistency and Corruption Detection
problem: File systems and storage systems must maintain crash consistency and detect corruption, but verification is tool-specific and hard to generalize
motivation: Reliable storage is foundational for AI system integrity; tool-agnostic verification methods improve trustworthiness across diverse storage backends
method: Tool-agnostic framework for verifying crash consistency properties and corruption detection mechanisms
key_novelty: First tool-agnostic approach to verifying crash consistency and corruption detection across diverse storage systems
contributions: Tool-agnostic verification framework for crash consistency
Applicable across multiple storage systems and tools
limitations: Title-only paper; specific verification techniques not described; performance overhead not quantified
